title: S&P 500 Valuation and Macro Financial Conditions Composite Model

inputs.name: CAPE valuation
inputs.transformation: 120-month rolling midrank percentile; >=80 high, <70 low; same signal month

inputs.name: 10-year real yield
inputs.transformation: daily observations averaged within prior calendar month; one-month lag; 120-month rolling midrank percentile

inputs.name: Financial conditions
inputs.transformation: latest weekly observation published by signal month-end using 5-calendar-day lag; 120-month rolling midrank percentile

inputs.name: Policy rate level
inputs.transformation: monthly average lagged one month; 120-month rolling midrank percentile

inputs.name: Policy direction
inputs.transformation: lagged monthly average change versus 12 months earlier; tightening >= +0.25pp score 100, easing <= -0.25pp score 0, otherwise 50

risk_percentile: Rolling 36-month midrank percentile of composite score, including current month. Q1-Q5 are relative to the trailing 36-month score history, not full-sample cutoffs.
forward_method: Forward return starts the month after signal month. Monthly total return is compounded in USD. Max drawdown is peak-to-trough on compounded forward wealth. Recovery is months from max-drawdown trough to first regain of pre-drawdown peak; null means not recovered within horizon.

valuation.source: Multpl monthly Shiller CAPE in project valuation-monthly-partial.csv

fedfunds.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED

dfii10.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
dfii10.note: Third-party FRED mirror downloaded 2026-10-12; not independently re-downloaded observation-by-observation in this run.

nfci.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago via FRED
nfci.frequency: weekly Friday-ending; latest observation available by month-end after conservative 5-calendar-day release lag
nfci.note: Third-party mirror. Chicago Fed/FRED historical NFCI values are revised; without ALFRED vintage data this is ex-post, not fully point-in-time. The latest mirror is not a live feed.

sp500_returns.note: Third-party Yahoo Finance-derived series; upstream redistribution rights not independently confirmed.

limitations: 127 complete monthly factor observations from 2016-01 to 2026-07; 92 score-percentile observations from 2018-12 after the 36-month score warm-up.
FEDFUNDS and DFII10 are lagged one month to avoid using a monthly average before it would normally be published; NFCI uses a conservative five-calendar-day publication lag.
NFCI is revised historically; without ALFRED vintage observations, historical point-in-time information is not fully reconstructed.
DFII10 and NFCI raw carrier files are third-party mirrors of official series and have not been independently re-downloaded observation-by-observation in this run.
Forward windows overlap and are not independent; horizon groups with small n are descriptive only.
ICE BofA high-yield OAS is excluded: FRED notes that from April 2026 only three years of history are provided and ICE prohibits redistribution of its top-level data without prior written permission.

Weights are transparent research assumptions, not fitted or optimized parameters. The present results do not establish a reliable monotonic risk-prediction relationship; no allocation rule should be deployed before rolling out-of-sample and block-bootstrap tests.
